body.name: b
body.type: \(b_{h,k}\) is the vector of the first \(k\) functions, in resolution order, of a boundary-corrected orthonormal tensor-product spline-wavelet basis on the cube centered at \(x_0\) with side length \(h\); its regularity and vanishing moments exceed \(\lfloor\gamma\rfloor+\lceil\max\{\alpha,\beta\}\rceil\), and it is zero off that cube
